# Purl

> A calm place to save and share the links you find. Free, no ads, no AI.

## What it does
- Save web pages, PDFs, YouTube videos and audio. Purl fetches the title, favicon, description and thumbnail.
- Organize links into folders (up to 100) and share any folder at a public link, purl.live/@username/folder.
- Free for everyone: up to 1,000 saved links per account.
- Save from a Chrome extension, a REST API or an MCP server.

## Pages
- Support: https://purl.live/support
- API: https://purl.live/docs/api
- MCP: https://purl.live/docs/mcp
- Privacy: https://purl.live/privacy
